description: An Aadhaar split across four JSON fields, reassembled, and sent to OpenAI from a function two calls below the request handler.
notes: The expected M1 result, stated plainly: the flow IS found and IS classified unmasked, but its traced source is only the `text` parameter of ask_model -- not the JSON fields it ultimately came from, because the trace does not cross function boundaries in this release. The split-value reassembly is likewise invisible to static analysis. Both are exactly what the canary harness exists to catch: seeding the four fields and watching a reassembled Aadhaar reach api.openai.com proves in M2 what no amount of static reading can.
